en: The Second Training Rule on Loud Laughter.
At that time, the Buddha, the Blessed One, was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
Now at that time, the group of six monks sat in inhabited areas making loud noises and great clamor... [etc. ...
"The training is to be observed: 'I shall sit in inhabited areas with little noise.
One should sit in inhabited areas with little noise."
If one, out of disrespect, sits in an inhabited area making loud noises and high-pitched sounds, there is an offense of wrong-doing (dukkaṭa).
There is no offense if it was unintentional … [and so forth] …
the fourth training rule is concluded.
